properties.description: Ten tests over an in-process MCP session (the served path, so the call's write unit is the one a client gets): answers draws INVALIDATES with each note; a missing finding refuses the call and writes nothing; a fix that answers nothing is ONE loop_status line until it names a finding or says `answers: []`; loop_status carries one repair line (standing patches, repairs nobody labelled); record_the_build writes every step with one receipt per step in the decision's order (verification, change, files, built), IMPLEMENTS from the test file, INVALIDATES from the change, CHANGED to each file, the capability realized, GOVERNED_BY to the decision; a refusal in the last step leaves nothing from the first three; a refusal names its step and tool; find_tools ranks record_the_build first for "record what I built" and its composed tools stay served; record_change and manual_work_report are unlisted and their names are refused with their replacements; 199 tools served.
properties.findings: FAILING FIRST on main (614487215): 9 of the 10 failed (no `answers` parameter, no loop fields, no record_the_build, the stubs still listed); the all-or-nothing test passed vacuously there because the tool did not exist. With the build: 10 of 10 pass (cargo test -p reflow2-mcp --no-default-features --test in_memory what_was_built_is_recorded_in_one_call::), and the full dev-test run of both crates without RocksDB passes.
properties.name: record_the_build and add_change_event's answers, over a real MCP session
